description: The calculation methods (equations of state) In Da Mix offers, with their ids for the method input. The current default is in the `default` field. Use when the user asks about calculation models: ideal versus real gas, compressibility, Z-factors, Peng-Robinson, MultiDeco. Use for "which gas models are supported", "ideal gas versus Peng-Robinson", "koje modele izračuna podržava aplikacija", "razlika između real gas i ideal gas". Always call it rather than relying on a remembered list. Answer: the methods and the current default; the differences briefly, only when asked; don't recommend switching unless the user asks. Then offer to compare the same blend across methods (blend with each method, the same inputs).
name: list_methods
title: Calculation methods
